title: Fuel Cost Calculator
description: Estimate trip fuel use and cost from distance, consumption and price per unit. The arithmetic stays in the browser.
intro: Enter distance, how much fuel the vehicle uses per 100 units of distance, and the price per fuel unit to estimate the trip cost.
blurb: Estimate fuel used and trip cost from distance, consumption and price.
howItWorks: Enter the trip distance, consumption per 100 of the same distance unit, and price per fuel unit.
Press Estimate. Fuel used is distance divided by 100, multiplied by consumption.
Cost is fuel used times price. Units are whatever you entered; the tool does not convert miles to litres.
examples: 120 distance units at 6.5 per 100 and price 1.8 costs 14.04.
Doubling the distance doubles both fuel and cost.
A zero price returns the fuel volume with a zero cost.

faq.a: It does not assume kilometres or miles. Consumption must be fuel units per 100 distance units, such as litres per 100 km. Keep price in the same fuel unit.

faq.q: Does it include tolls or stops?
faq.a: No. It only multiplies distance, consumption and price. Real trips also depend on speed, load and idling.
No. The estimate is calculated in the page.
